## Period column cleaning

```{r}
#| echo: false
proximity_clean <- proximity |> mutate(Periods) |> separate_wider_delim(
  Periods,
  delim = "JJ",
  names = c("Periods","Rest")) |> mutate(Periods = as.numeric(Periods)) |>select(!Rest)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
rent_clean <- rent |> mutate(Periods) |> separate_wider_delim(
  Periods,
  delim = "JJ",
  names = c("Periods","Rest")) |> mutate(Periods = as.numeric(Periods)) |>select(!Rest)
```

## Data description

Github link: https://github.com/martin-carricas-asin/Dutch-Rent-Analysis

*Data sources:*

- Proximity to facilities, regional data: https://opendata.cbs.nl/portal.html?\_la=en&\_catalog=CBS&tableId=80305ENG&\_theme=1187

- Rent increase data: https://opendata.cbs.nl/portal.html?\_la=en&\_catalog=CBS&tableId=83162ENG&\_theme=1175

The the source of the data sets is CBS Open data Statline which is the database of the Statistics Netherlands. This is an independent government institution responsible for gathering and publishing various official statistics about the Netherlands.

## Individual Dataset Descriptives

### Rent Dataset

The rent dataset has `r nrow(rent)` rows and `r ncol(rent)` columns

```{r}
#| echo: false
rent_region <- rent_clean |>
  rename(rent_incl=RentIncreaseIncludingHarmonisation_1,
         rent_excl = RentIncreaseExcludingHarmonisation_2)|>
  filter(Regions %in% c("NL01", "LD01", "LD02", "LD03","LD04"))|>
  summarise(
    across(c(rent_incl,rent_excl),
      list(
        mean    = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd      = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        min     = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max     = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")
  )|>
  pivot_longer(everything())|>
  separate_wider_delim(name, delim = "__", names = c("variable", "statistic")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value)|>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.x,2)))

rent_region
```

## Joined Dataset

```{r}

proximity_rent <- proximity_clean |>
  inner_join(rent_clean, by=join_by(Regions, Periods))
```

## Variable Description

## Main Variable: Rent

```{r}
#| echo: false
common_limits <- range(
  c(proximity_rent$RentIncreaseIncludingHarmonisation_1,
    proximity_rent$RentIncreaseExcludingHarmonisation_2),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```



### Graphical Representation

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Rent increase including Harmonisation

```{r}
#| echo: false
proximity_rent |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=Periods,y=RentIncreaseIncludingHarmonisation_1, group = Regions,
    color = Regions)) + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = common_limits)
  
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Rent increase excluding Harmonisation

```{r}
#| echo: false
proximity_rent |> ggplot(aes(x=Periods,y=RentIncreaseExcludingHarmonisation_2, group = Regions,
    color = Regions)) + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = common_limits)

```
:::
